mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the federal funds rate below 4.5% signals monetary easing, compressing discount rates on equity cash flows and generating positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns in easing periods are not significantly higher than baseline (t-test p > 0.05) or FEDFUNDS decline does not persist below 4.5% for 30 days.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained quarterly increase in GDPC1 (GDP) growth above 3% signals robust demand, boosting corporate earnings expectations and driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20d returns do not rise significantly (t-test p > 0.05) during periods of GDPC1 growth above 3%.

mechanism_narrative: A combination of falling FEDFUNDS rates below 4.5% and rising UNRATE above 4.7% creates conflicting signals: monetary easing offsets labor market strengthening, leading to negative 20-day S&P 500 returns.
candidate_trigger: FEDFUNDS < 4.5% and UNRATE rises > 0.2 percentage points in 3 months
regime_hint: weak labor market with easing policy
failure_condition: 20d returns remain positive despite the FEDFUNDS-UNRATE combination meeting the trigger, or the interaction's statistical significance (Rank IC) falls below 0.05.

mechanism_narrative: When the CPIAUCSL index exceeds 2.0, signaling accelerating inflation, investors anticipate higher interest rates, leading to compression in equity valuations and negative 20-day S&P 500 returns.
failure_condition: 20d returns do not decline significantly (t-test p > 0.05) when CPIAUCSL crosses above 2.0.

mechanism_narrative: In a late-cycle expansion, a sustained decline in FEDFUNDS rates amplifies equity valuation compression, driving positive 20-day S&P 500 returns as investors anticipate prolonged higher rates.
failure_condition: 20d returns in late-cycle expansion periods do not rise significantly (p > 0.05) despite FEDFUNDS declines, or the effect is not stronger than in non-late-cycle periods.

mechanism_narrative: When quarterly GDPC1 growth exceeds 2% while INDPRO falls below 105 (indicating supply contraction), inflationary pressures intensify, leading to negative 60-day S&P 500 returns as investors anticipate rate hikes.
candidate_trigger: GDPC1 up > 2% and INDPRO down > 1% in 3 months
failure_condition: 60d returns do not decline significantly (p > 0.05) when the trigger occurs, or the interaction's statistical significance (Rank IC) is below 0.05.

mechanism_narrative: A sharp drop in UNRATE below 4.5% signals a strengthening labor market, boosting corporate profits and equity valuations, resulting in positive 5-day S&P 500 forward returns.
failure_condition: 5d returns do not rise significantly (t-test p > 0.05) when UNRATE crosses below 4.5%, or the effect is not sustained beyond the day of crossing.

mechanism_narrative: Rising PAYEMS (payroll employment) indicates a robust labor market, enhancing corporate earnings expectations and driving positive 5-day S&P 500 forward returns.
failure_condition: 5d returns do not rise significantly (p > 0.05) during periods of PAYEMS growth, or the correlation with employment trends is weak (Rank IC < 0.03).
